title: THE STACK · FULL BODY CABLE AMRAP · 20:00
vibe: GREEN · ~32 MIN · INTENSE, ONE STACK, EVERY PATTERN
why: The machine was taken yesterday, so nothing has been lifted since 11-03 and nothing is sore: full intensity is on the table. One cable stack, every pattern in one 20-minute AMRAP: squat, hinge, lunge, vertical pull, horizontal push, rear delts, side delts. Eight stations, ten reps each, as many rounds as the clock allows, loads heavy enough that round 4 is a fight. Pulley heights are grouped (low for 1-4, high for 5-7, back to low for 8) so you change twice a round. Loads in kg, the empty round sets them.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 5 MIN · FULL BODY
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · Moves Method Day B legs plus shoulders, then one empty round

items.name: One empty round
items.detail: 5 reps of each station with the pin out, learn the heights, set the loads

blocks.title: AMRAP 20:00 · 8 STATIONS × 10 REPS
blocks.meta: AMRAP 20:00 · target 4 ROUNDS (GREEN 5) · stations 1-4 low pulley, 5-7 high pulley, 8 low · rest only when a set breaks
blocks.format: AMRAP on a clock, full body
blocks.workRest: 20:00 continuous · count rounds and extra stations

items.name: 1 · Cable front squat, handle at the chest, start 30 kg
items.detail: x10 · low pulley, face the stack, sit back into the cable, chest up, stand hard

items.name: 2 · Cable Romanian deadlift, rope, start 35 kg
items.detail: x10 · low pulley, back to the stack, hinge long, snap the hips

items.name: 3 · Cable reverse lunge, handle at the chest, start 12 kg
items.detail: x10/side · low pulley, the cable pulls you forward, stay tall

items.name: 4 · Cable biceps curl, bar or rope, start 20 kg
items.detail: x10 · low pulley, elbows pinned, 2-count down

items.name: 5 · Lat pulldown, kneeling or seated, start 40 kg
items.detail: x10 · high pulley, bar or both handles, elbows to the hips, chest tall

items.name: 6 · Standing cable chest fly, start 12 kg per side
items.detail: x10 · high pulley, split stance, squeeze the handles together at the sternum. WILDCARD: single stack, one arm at a time

items.name: 7 · Cable reverse fly, crossed handles, start 8 kg per side
items.detail: x10 · high pulley, grab the opposite handles, arms long, pull wide to a T, 1 s squeeze

items.name: 8 · Single-arm cable lateral raise, start 8 kg
items.detail: x10/side · low pulley, stand side-on, raise to shoulder height, 2-count down

blocks.text: Four rounds in 20:00 is the floor. GREEN: five. If a station leaves you with easy reps in round 2, go up a plate on it immediately and write the new number. Nothing is sore and nothing has been lifted in a week, so push the loads, not the rest.

blocks.meta: 2 ROUNDS · cable and floor · rest 30 s between rounds

items.name: Kneeling cable crunch, rope, 25 kg
items.detail: x12, rope behind the head, round toward the knees, hips still

items.name: Standing pallof press, 12 kg
items.detail: x10/side, press out, 2 s hold, hips square
